map.打击率 = 安打/打数；ERA = 自责分×9/局: AVG = hits/at-bats; ERA = earned runs × 9 / innings

map.OPS .800 为优秀，.900+ 为 MVP 级；ERA 越低越好，3.00: OPS of .800 is excellent, .900+ is MVP level; the lower the ERA the better, under 3.00 is excellent

map.安打 30 / 打数 100 → 打击率 AVG=0.300；ERA=自责分×9: 30 hits / 100 at-bats -> AVG = 0.300; ERA = earned runs × 9 / innings, 3 earned runs ÷ 7 innings × 9 ≈ 3.86.
map.MLB 均值约 .250，.300 以上出众。: The MLB average is about .250; .300 or above is outstanding.
map.OPS 比 AVG 更全面吗？: Is OPS more comprehensive than AVG?
map.OPS 合并上垒与长打能力，比单一 AVG 更能反映打者综合进攻价值。: OPS combines on-base and slugging ability, reflecting a hitter's overall offensive value better than AVG alone.
map.打击：打击率 AVG = 安打 ÷ 打数；上垒率 OBP = (安打+保送+触身: Batting: AVG = hits ÷ at-bats; OBP = (hits + walks + hit-by-pitch) ÷ (at-bats + walks + hit-by-pitch + sacrifice flies); SLG = (singles + 2×doubles + 3×triples + 4×home runs) ÷ at-bats, where singles = hits − doubles − triples − home runs (negative values are clamped to 0); OPS = OBP + SLG; ISO = SLG − AVG; total bases TB = the SLG numerator. Pitching (innings use the decimal digit as outs ÷ 3, so 6.2 means 6⅔ innings): ERA = earned runs ÷ innings × 9; WHIP = (hits allowed + walks) ÷ innings. Validation: invalid at-bats or innings are only highlighted and do not stop the calculation, and division-by-zero items show "–". Criteria: AVG ≥0.330 elite, ≥0.300 excellent, ≥0.270 above average, ≥0.250 near average, otherwise low; OPS ≥0.900 MVP level, ≥0.800 excellent, ≥0.700 qualified, ≥0.600 average; ERA ≤2.50 Cy Young level, ≤3.00 elite, ≤3.75 excellent, ≤4.50 qualified, ≤5.00 average; each metric is also compared with the MLB average to show the deviation.
